title_en: Application Guide: Grading Option Selection for Major Courses of Other Departments, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: This notice announces the application period for selecting a grading option for major courses offered by other departments (divisions) in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. The notice text does not state the dates or procedure, which appear to be in the attached document, and that attachment was not read.
translation:

Posted: 2026-08-31

We are announcing the application period for the Grading Option Selection System for major courses of other departments (divisions) for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year.

▶ 1,424 courses across 16 colleges
